prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1202; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical strain, or whiplash. The mechanism of injury described is a plausible cause of these symptoms. Over the course of care the patient attended a total of 30 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of injury. Physical examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness that support the reported injury, while certain neurological screening tests and imaging-related assessments returned normal results. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving the cervical spine. Billing records were reviewed and show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing management includes home exercise instruction, periodic reassessment, and a plan to taper care as symptoms allow.
